sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL still shows APR-009 as approved, but the newer 8D report says the HB-620 approval for Fonderia Dora was revoked on 2026-09-15. That date is after the 2026-09-01 meeting but before today (2026-11-14). The ASL entry is therefore outdated, and there is no current approval to keep ordering against. The ASL should be corrected.
